data.title: Telling Time — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: time
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(It's a rainy morning at home)

[Hook]
Tick-tock… Tic-tac
Time flies… El tiempo vuela
Learn the clock… Aprende el reloj
One more time… Una vez más
Let's sing along.

[Verse]
Waking up… Despertarse
To the sound of raindrops on the roof.
Good morning… Buenos días
The morning… La mañana
Is calling me to start my day.
Thankful for… Agradecido por
This quiet time, just me and you.
To go to sleep… Irse a dormir
When the day is through.

[Hook]
Tick-tock… Tic-tac
Time flies… El tiempo vuela
Learn the clock… Aprende el reloj
One more time… Una vez más
Let's sing along.

[Verse]
Sunset… El atardecer
Painting skies in shades of gold.
Counting hours… Contando horas
Till midnight… La medianoche
Tells a new day to unfold.
Nap time… La siesta
In the afternoon, the afternoon.
Early morning… La madrugada
When dreams are born.

[Bridge]
Dawn… El alba
A new beginning, a fresh start.
Time for learning… Tiempo para aprender
Every moment, every part.
In the afternoon… En la tarde
